payload.reason: The evidence provides comparative performance results of the proposed augmentation method (text smoothing) against other baselines, showing significant improvements in accuracy.

claims.text: Text smoothing outperforms the previous best method, BARTspan, by 1.17% in average accuracy.
Text smoothing significantly improves various baseline data augmentation methods by up to 6.48%.
The experiments were conducted in a low-resource regime, ensuring fair comparison by equalizing data amounts.
